gloss: distribution board; breaker panel; fuse box

definitions.gloss: distribution board; breaker panel; electrical panel
definitions.explanation: A panel inside a home or building that receives incoming electricity from the utility supply and splits it among the circuits that run through the building. It houses the main breaker and the individual circuit breakers for each room or appliance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (divide, distribute) + {電|でん} (electricity) + ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (board, panel). A technical term for the electrical panel inside a home or commercial building. In a typical Japanese home it is mounted on a wall near the entrance, in a hallway, or in a closet, and houses the main breaker, a leakage breaker, and individual circuit breakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分電盤|ぶんでんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブレーカー→ブレーカー：07496_bureekaa⟧: the breakers on the distribution board
- {分電盤|ぶんでんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace the distribution board
- {分電盤|ぶんでんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the distribution board
- {分電盤|ぶんでんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside the distribution board
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧{分電盤|ぶんでんばん}: residential distribution board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ブレーカー→ブレーカー：07496_bureekaa⟧: breaker — refers to an individual circuit breaker, not the whole panel.
- ⟦{配電盤|はいでんばん}→配電盤：24891_haidenban⟧: switchboard — a larger panel used in commercial buildings and substations to distribute electricity at higher capacities.
- ヒューズ{箱|ばこ}: fuse box — an older style of panel that used replaceable fuses instead of breakers; mostly obsolete.

USAGE:
You will encounter {分電盤|ぶんでんばん} in home-inspection reports, renovation estimates, safety notices from the power company, and when calling an electrician. Most homeowners only deal with it when a breaker trips and they need to reset it.
